headline: Shout it, and it's on tape: TALK ME DOWN records your voice orders
lede: Seat 1 finally sees what to shout, and every call you make — obeyed, refused, or nonsense — now lands in the replay file as its own trace. Voice co-op is fully recorded, phones included.

notes.text: #1415 shipped (#1446): every heard call banks into recordings as voiceCmd — words, meaning, consent, and the refusal reason; the defuser's LCD rail etches the accepted call shapes under the orders display.
Gauntlet's #1249 pattern: the natural game loop feeds the recorder under isRecording(), and one shared ACCEPTED_HINT const keeps the printed manual, the footer and the grammar from ever drifting.

A capture must OPEN on tick zero — reset+release+recordStart in one JS task — or every banked hash sits ahead of the replay clock. Also fixed: the firecrew nightly's 100->131 rAF race (#1449) that froze the merge lane.
